status: Planning coverage review only; neither source capability nor metric implementation is claimed complete.

summary.catalog_label_fix: files_changed now says Files changed; additional neutral label fixes and definition fields applied.

eligibility_classes.automatic baseline: May compute in the initial public-data release after source, identity, scope and policy gates pass. Describes measured activity or merged artifact participation; does not certify subjective quality.
eligibility_classes.conditional: Enabled only when its optional source, historical context, timestamps, target feature and actor evidence are proven. Otherwise explicitly unavailable/partial.
eligibility_classes.evidence-reviewed: Requires an accepted receipt or explicit source review satisfying category criteria; ingestion alone does not award it. Can launch with the receipt workflow.
eligibility_classes.descriptive-only: May compute from supported data but appears as context/distribution or a raw drilldown, without merit/quality ranking. Advanced source prerequisites still apply.
eligibility_classes.deferred advanced: Outside initial implementation; stays disabled until separately scoped, reviewed and validated.

common_contract.filter_scope: Same repository/Project/workstream/date/actor eligibility filters must constrain numerator, denominator and evidence. Distinguish current mapping from supported event-time mapping.
common_contract.null_semantics: Zero only for complete supported scope with no eligible units. Missing permissions, timestamps, lineage, optional feature or complete history means unavailable or partial, not zero.
common_contract.non_additivity: Metric families, authorship roles, category facets and cross-Project memberships overlap. Never sum them into unique work, effort or quality. Shared participation may exceed unique artifact count.
common_contract.count_denominator: Count and sum metrics have no mathematical denominator; show eligible source coverage and population separately. Do not divide by days/hours to manufacture productivity.
common_contract.time: UTC half-open event windows; no ingestion-time substitution; current-state metrics must say as of snapshot.
common_contract.grouping: Any time-bucket grouping and suppression rules are exact versioned policy; publication blocks if a qualitative requirement remains unreviewed or undefined.
common_contract.minimum_samples: For descriptive ratios/distributions always show numerator, denominator or n. Optional comparison thresholds need an approved numeric policy; there is no default personal ratio leaderboard.
common_contract.attribution: User account is observed actor, not certified manual effort. Distinguish author, coauthor, reviewer, merger, closer, assignee, resolver and automation. Model trailers are metadata.

clarifications.finding: Verified sender identity cannot establish manual execution.
clarifications.requested_change: Replace manual verified sender evidence with observed sender attribution and independently declared execution mode; include an agent acting under a User account fixture.

clarifications.finding: An unavailable source cannot verify a claim, but a documented failed recheck can be a reviewed contribution.
clarifications.requested_change: Explicitly permit evidence-reviewed freshness effort whose outcome is unavailable/changed/contradicted, while withholding verified-source or accepted-fact credit.

clarifications.finding: Evidence row count does not equal all aggregate values. Sum/difference/ratio/distribution metrics need a derivation, not a count of rows.
clarifications.requested_change: Each displayed value must reconcile through its declared aggregation and unit to eligible evidence; count metrics use cardinality, LOC uses sums, ratios show numerator/denominator, durations show n and distribution.

clarifications.finding: Generic ratio support lacks exact cohort/censoring acceptance cases.
clarifications.requested_change: Add decided-in-window PR ratio with merged plus closed-unmerged denominator; separate pending cases. Add ready-to-first-submitted-review durations, n, missing readiness evidence and unresolved censored PRs. These are descriptive diagnostics, not individual quality/speed rankings.

clarifications.finding: Native issue fields and Project status-update posts are distinct from Project item custom fields and item status transitions; existing prose is broad.
clarifications.requested_change: Name and test all four separately: native IssueFieldChangedEvent, projects_v2_item field edits, ProjectV2ItemStatusChangedEvent and projects_v2_status_update publications. Disable unsupported subtypes.

clarifications.finding: Retained-line blame has no dedicated bounded implementation work package and should not be implied by generic LOC scope.
clarifications.requested_change: Keep explicitly deferred advanced. Before enabling, create a separately owned package for bounded read-only blame, snapshot ancestry, moved-code/formatting/import limitations, privacy and UI caveats.

clarifications.finding: General evidence review supports these, but domain categories and acceptance examples are only implicit.
clarifications.requested_change: Add one accepted/rejected receipt example each for governance decisions, sanitized deployment work and reliability/postmortem contribution. No automatic incident-count merit or human credit from CI execution.

clarifications.finding: Live PullRequestReviewThread schema has resolvedBy and isResolved but no resolvedAt. Current resolver identity can be known while historical event date/transition history is unknown.
clarifications.requested_change: Treat current resolvedBy as current state; period metrics require a proven timestamped observed transition or receipt. Do not infer resolvedAt from latest PR updatedAt or assume resolver made the underlying code fix.

clarifications.finding: Meaningful, substantive and corrected are review judgments unless an exact mechanical rule is published.
clarifications.requested_change: Automatic baseline counts observed distinct triage groups with raw labels. Qualified clarification/correction boards require evidence acceptance. Approve grouping interval and repeated-state suppression through policy, not subjective classifier guesses.

clarifications.finding: Audit demonstrates stacked PR double counting: 107 commit entries, 92 unique SHAs and 11 intermediate-branch merges.
clarifications.requested_change: Count PR merge events with target-branch facet, but delivered LOC only once on verified default-branch integration. Include exact stacked research sequence as sanitized acceptance fixture and preserve original contributor roles.

clarifications.finding: AI model trailers are not human identities, while a user account can drive an agent.
clarifications.requested_change: Preserve declared AI model/version as assistance metadata; do not create a contributor identity from Claude Opus 5.5 trailer or publish its email. Do not detect AI use by style.

clarifications.finding: Applying labels does not cover creating or maintaining the label definitions themselves.
clarifications.requested_change: Add explicit label taxonomy adapter and evidence-receipt fallback with creation, rename, description/color changes, archive/unarchive and deletion facets only as proven by each source action. Current definitions do not reconstruct historical editors.
source_acceptance_cases: A label rename retains the same label identity and yields one definition-change group, not one new label plus changed applications on every issue.
Creating a label and applying it to an issue yield two distinct typed facts; they do not become two completed outcomes.
Description/color no-op edits, repeated reversals and bulk setup are suppressed/grouped by the published policy.
Canary proves label webhook action payload, sender, before/after semantics and occurrence timestamp. Metadata read is documented for subscription; verify hydration endpoint permission separately.
Missing event time, ghost sender, missing deleted definition or pre-install history remains partial; a reviewed receipt is clearly labeled.

clarifications.finding: Milestoning an issue does not cover milestone creation and definition stewardship.
clarifications.requested_change: Add milestone-definition adapter for creation/title/description/due-date/state changes and deletion where source supports them, distinct from item membership.
source_acceptance_cases: Canary distinguishes milestone created/edited/closed/reopened events from issue milestoned/demilestoned events.
One due-date adjustment updates one milestone definition group rather than creating a contribution per attached issue.
Milestone creator is used for proven creation only, never assumed to be every editor.
Closing a milestone produces a state fact, not proof every scoped issue was delivered.
Verify documented Issues OR Pull requests read subscription permission and actual event timestamp coverage; unsupported actions use reviewed receipts.

clarifications.finding: Project item values do not cover Project field definitions, options, views, layouts and workflow configuration.
clarifications.requested_change: Add one reviewed Project configuration change-set category with typed facets, rather than manufacturing a score for every option or resulting automated item update.
source_acceptance_cases: Accepted receipt links public before/after evidence and contributor role for adding/renaming a field or option without treating each item using it as another authored change.
View filter/group/sort/layout changes and workflow enabled/disabled/configuration changes each have an explicit receipt fixture.
ProjectV2 fields/views/workflows snapshot metadata does not prove who edited it; current creator and updatedAt are insufficient.
A changed Project workflow followed by 100 automated item updates yields one reviewed configuration change plus 100 clearly automated raw observations.

Canary tests whether any exact configuration subtype has actor-bearing events; only proven subtypes may graduate to automatic observation. Do not request new admin permissions merely to fill a scoreboard.

clarifications.finding: Reference links and closures do not explicitly cover moving an issue between repositories.
clarifications.requested_change: Add transfer stewardship with verified source/destination lineage and attribution, preserving original authorship and evidence while counting no new issue or solution.
source_acceptance_cases: Public-to-public transfer uses TransferredEvent actor/createdAt/fromRepository and proven target identity; duplicate representations map to one transition.
Changed issue numbers/URLs retain canonical alias lineage; source and destination views do not duplicate issue-created counts.
Transfer to a private or unapproved repository immediately suppresses affected public content and cached projections.
Missing source/destination identity remains partial and is never guessed from current assignee or title similarity.
Back-and-forth transfer loops yield raw transitions but no accumulating qualified merit.

clarifications.finding: Parent/child edges and priority field changes do not cover curated subissue or Project item order. No actor-bearing reorder history was proven.
clarifications.requested_change: Add reviewed ordering-change receipts with parent/Project scope and before/after evidence; keep automatic reorder attribution disabled until the exact subtype source is proven.
source_acceptance_cases: A reviewed plan that reorders ten children is one change set, not ten accepted outcomes.
Current ordered list or snapshot difference alone produces no named actor credit or fabricated timestamp.
Dragging an item away and back, or applying an automatic view sort, does not create repeated manual ordering credit.
Reparenting, changing a priority field and reordering are distinct facts and may share one receipt without additive overall credit.
Canary checks reorder event/API history independently of subissue add/remove; if unsupported, label receipt-based coverage and do not add privileges.

clarifications.finding: Issue labels/edits do not expressly represent public pinning, locking and discussion stewardship. Such action counts should not rank enforcement.
clarifications.requested_change: Provide an unranked public stewardship facet with actor-backed pin/unpin/lock/unlock observations and approved receipts for unsupported public actions.
source_acceptance_cases: PinnedEvent/UnpinnedEvent and LockedEvent/UnlockedEvent fixtures preserve actor/time and group repeated toggles.
Issue-comment pin has its own source object; current pinnedBy/pinnedAt may prove the extant pin but not all prior pin/unpin history.
No quality, justification, offender identity or sanction severity is inferred from lock or pin actions.
Private moderation, organization bans, private reports and restricted reasons stay excluded; no organization Administration permission is introduced.
Editorial recognition of moderation work requires a sanitized approved receipt; public raw counts remain descriptive only.

overall_findings: All 98 IDs map to existing reviewable work packages. Retained-line analysis is deliberately deferred, not covertly included in baseline LOC.
Most specialty metrics are covered by the common evidence receipt/review workflow plus a domain package. They must not appear automatically qualified merely because a PR merged.
Unit/aggregation/numerator/denominator fields have been added to each catalog metric so count, sum, ratio and duration semantics are machine-readable.
No numerical minimum-sample threshold was invented; descriptive diagnostics always show n and do not rank personal quality.
Projects 1-5 and future explicitly approved IDs replace stale 1/2/3 references; historic association remains evidence-constrained.
Live review-thread schema exposes resolvedBy but not resolvedAt; current-state identity and period attribution are different capabilities.

Six additional forms explicitly cover label/milestone definitions, Project configuration, issue transfers/order and public moderation; repository configuration stays an evidence-backed facet of existing governance rather than a duplicate metric.

sources.review_thread_schema_probe: The planning GraphQL schema probe observed resolvedBy/isResolved and no resolvedAt on PullRequestReviewThread. See the sanitized capability findings in metric-api-evidence.json; re-probe at implementation time.
